title: ALP Accepted Adaptation Decision
description: A canonical, append-only workspace record (adaptation-decisions/<id>.yaml) of an adaptation choice the learner explicitly confirmed for one unit of a shared Learning Target (ADR-0060, ADR-0061). It is an input to the Target Adaptation Projection, not part of it, so it survives projection rebuilds. Agents may only propose; only the learner confirms. A decision is revoked or replaced by a later record that supersedes it.

learnerId.description: The workspace learner who confirmed the decision.

unit.description: Opaque, declared-stable platform item ID of the unit the decision applies to.

action.description: accept binds a mode for the unit (superseding any active decision for it); revoke supersedes an active decision without replacing it.

projectionRevision.description: The Target Adaptation Projection revision the learner confirmed against.

confirmedBy.description: Only the learner can confirm an adaptation decision; agents may only propose.
